headline: Chat Templates Change How Models Say I
lede: A study of eight open-source models finds that conversational wrappers alter self-referential language in measurable ways. Templates increased AI disclaimers, suppressed experiential phrasing, and even exposed a controllable mid-layer activation direction—warning that model self-reports may partly reflect formatting rather than inner properties.

headline: Flip Dots Become a Fluid Simulator
lede: Salvaged flipdot panels become the unlikely surface for a FLIP fluid simulation. The build required reverse-engineered magnetic actuators, custom H-bridge driver boards, careful power management, and persistence through brownouts, uneven flips, and mounting problems.

headline: Georgism Moves From Theory Toward Practice
lede: Five years after making the case for land-value taxation, Lars Doucet finds the idea edging toward implementation. New enabling laws, better valuation data, and practical modeling tools move the argument from internet debate to local political work.
pullquote: Land-value taxation is becoming a policy program, not merely a theory.

headline: OpenAI Files Expose the Cost of Optics
lede: Unsealed filings in the Authors Guild case allege that OpenAI executives knew books came from LibGen and worried about how that would look on Hacker News. The documents put acquisition practices, author displacement, and corporate risk management in the same uncomfortable frame.

headline: Meta Cuts Lula Off Before Election Day
lede: Two weeks before Brazil’s election, Meta blocked President Lula’s Facebook page and campaign advertising. The action turns a platform enforcement decision into an immediate question of electoral access, private power, and due process.

headline: Go Concurrency, Distilled to Its Sharp Edges
lede: This compact field guide maps goroutines, channels, cancellation, synchronization, atomics, and diagnostics. Its practical lesson is less about starting work than stopping it cleanly, preventing leaks, and distinguishing a data race from a broader coordination failure.

headline: PipePipe Forks NewPipe for More Control
lede: PipePipe takes the NewPipe codebase in its own direction, adding SponsorBlock, Return YouTube Dislike, background playback, filtering, and frequent fixes. Install it through F-Droid or another repository; expect a separate maintenance path and a sharper break from the official client.

headline: LightCloud Puts the Stack in One Folder
lede: LightCloud treats an application as a folder containing its frontend, backend, Postgres database, environment, and branch previews. Git pushes trigger builds, deployments choose between CDN hosting and Cloud Run, and scale-to-zero billing keeps the configuration surface deliberately small.

headline: GitHub Ships More CSS and Runs Faster
lede: GitHub’s migration from CSS-in-JS to CSS Modules moves styling work into generated stylesheets and out of runtime paths. The result: server-side rendering time fell 55% in Primer, while component initialization dropped 25%.

headline: DeepSeek Builds Elastic Sandboxes for Agents
lede: Dsec is infrastructure for agents that need isolated, stateful software environments at bursty scale. Its layered images, memory reclamation, preemption-safe rollouts, and mixed function-to-VM backends support roughly three million sandbox instances each day without treating containers as the whole answer.
